title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.title: Mike Evans (groin) planning to play Week 1
items.desc: Mike Evans is planning to play in Week 1 as he continues to deal with a groin injury.
items.impact: Evans' groin injury is being described as "minor" after missing back-to-back practices this week. The veteran's status should be monitored leading up to the opening week of the regular season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Downs (calf) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Josh Downs did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Downs missed practice for undisclosed reasons on Tuesday and it is now said to be a calf injury. He remains day-to-day.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyler Warren (groin) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Tyler Warren did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Warren remains likely to miss practice all of this week as he recovers from a groin injury. His status for Week 1 is not in danger yet if he can return to practice by next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tucker Kraft (knee) to participate in 11-on-11 drills in joint practice
items.desc: Tucker Kraft will participate in 11-on-11 drills in the Packers joint practice with Cardinals.
items.impact: Kraft returned to team drills earlier in August. He remains on track to be good to go for Week 1 in September.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Joe Burrow, Bengals starters will not play in preseason finale
items.desc: The Bengals starters will not play in Friday's preseason finale against the Eagles.
items.impact: We will see Joe Burrow and the starters for Cincinnati back on the field in Week 1 against the Bucs.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: James Conner (foot) progressing, uncertain for Week 1
items.desc: James Conner is progressing from his foot injury, but he remains uncertain for Week 1.
items.impact: Conner's role in the Cardinals backfield remains unclear following the offseason additions of Jeremiyah Love and Tyler Allgeier.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mekhi Blackmon waived by Colts
items.desc: The Colts have waived CB Mekhi Blackmon.
items.impact: Indianapolis acquired Blackmon last year. He appeared in all 17 games for the Colts last season with 11 starts.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Deshaun Watson, starters will not play Thursday
items.desc: Deshaun Watson and the Browns starters will not play in Thursday's preseason finale against the Patriots.
items.impact: We will see Watson and the starters for Cleveland back on the field in Week 1 against the Jaguars.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Bryce Young, Panthers starters will not play Friday
items.desc: The Panthers starters will not play in Friday's preseason finale against the Texans.
items.impact: We will see Young and the starters for Carolina back on the field in Week 1 against the Bears.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Darnell Wright (elbow) practices Wednesday
items.desc: Darnell Wright returned to practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Wright avoids a scare following his early exit from practice on Tuesday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Luther Burden III (groin) back at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Luther Burden III returned to practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Burden was back on the field for the first time since injuring his groin on August 8. He went through individual drills and went inside when 7 on 7 started. This should put him on track to be good to go for Week 1.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Michael Penix Jr. will not play Friday
items.desc: Michael Penix Jr. will not play in Friday's preseason finale against the Dolphins.
items.impact: Penix was cleared for team drills last weekend. Tua Tagovailoa will start on Friday. The starting job for Atlanta in Week 1 remains up in the air.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tua Tagovailoa to start preseason finale Friday
items.desc: Tua Tagovailoa will start Friday's preseason game against the Dolphins.
items.impact: Tagovailoa will close out the preseason against his former team. Michael Penix Jr. will not play. The starter role for Week 1 remains up in the air.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Braden Smith believed to have suffered foot injury Wednesday
items.desc: Braden Smith is believed to have suffered a foot injury during practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Smith was carted off the field with the injury. He'll likely continue to be further evaluated.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Jacobs: Packers preparing for possible suspension
items.desc: Packers GM Brian Gutekunst said they've been preparing for scenario of Josh Jacobs being suspended
items.impact: ESPN's Adam Schefter said in August that the league would likely suspend Jacobs, who was arrested on domestic abuse charges in May. If he is suspended, MarShawn Lloyd would figure to lead the backfield.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ja'Marr Chase (knee) not practicing Wednesday
items.desc: Ja'Marr Chase is not practicing on Wednesday.
items.impact: Chase appeared to have avoided a scary injury during Tuesday's practice. He was not wearing any protective equipment on the knee, which is notable.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zay Flowers misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Zay Flowers did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Flowers remained sidelined after also not practicing on Monday. Wacker notes that he appeared to tweak his ankle last week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rueben Bain Jr. suffers AC sprain, expected to be ready for Week 1
items.desc: Bucs first-round pick Reuben Bain Jr. suffered an AC sprain, but he is expected to be ready for Week 1.
items.impact: It is said to be "nothing serious." Bain will still be worth monitoring over the next couple of weeks.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Calvin Austin III (knee) out for the season with torn ACL
items.desc: Calvin Austin III (knee) is out for the season with a torn ACL that he suffered during Tuesday's practice.
items.impact: Austin was trying to find his way onto the field in a crowded Giants receiver room, and now finds himself out for the season. He was in a contract year, so this is a big blow to him heading into to free agency. His dynasty value is pretty much rock bottom at this point, but hopefully he can make a comeback and find a team.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Quinshon Judkins returns to team drills
items.desc: Quinshon Judkins returned to team drills during practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Judkins missed two practices last week and was limited to individual work on Monday. He was back full-go on Tuesday.

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.title: Trey Benson clears waivers, returns to Cardinals
items.desc: Trey Benson cleared waivers on Tuesday and will now return to Arizona's injured reserve list.
items.impact: Benson suffered a torn meniscus last season, and it flared up early in training camp this summer. The running back will remain on the injured reserve for the Cardinals, who have a plethora of running backs in Jeremiyah Love, Tyler Allgeier and James Conner.

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.title: D.J. Humphries signs with Commanders
items.desc: D.J. Humphries signed a 1-year deal with the Washington Commanders on Tuesday.
items.impact: Humphries will bring a strong veteran presence to the Washington offensive line, which just lost Laremy Tunsil for the majority, if not all, of the 2026 season. Humphries appeared in eight games for the Rams last season and was last a full-time starter with the Cardinals in 2023.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Justin Herbert, starters will play Thursday
items.desc: Justin Herbert and most of Los Angeles' starters will play in Thursday's preseason finale against the Los Angeles Rams.
items.impact: HC Jim Harbaugh told reporters that Herbert and most of the team's starters are going to play in their final preseason game on Thursday night, with the exception of a few veterans. It remains unlikely that the starting unit will see more than a quarter or two of action, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) not practicing Tuesday
items.desc: TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) is not practicing on Tuesday.
items.impact: Henderson is expected to be a non-participant at New England's practice on Tuesday due to the ankle injury that he suffered on Monday. It's not expected to be a serious issue, but this is a situation worth monitoring for fantasy managers over the next couple of weeks.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Chris Olave slow to get up Tuesday at practice
items.desc: Chris Olave was slow to get up after doing a deep route in practice, landing hard on his back. HC Kellen Moore said that the receiver had the wind knocked out of him, and when asked if there would be further tests or cause for concern, declined to answer.
items.impact: It sounds like Olave should be fine. He shouldn't suffer any setbacks because of this unless the staff is hiding details. Draft Olave with confidence as the WR1 in an up and coming Saints offense.

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.title: Sam LaPorta (hip) returns to practice Tuesday
items.desc: Sam Laporta returned to practice on Tuesday after suffering a hip injury last week.
items.impact: Laporta's hip injury has made his status for Week 1 murky, but his returning to practice this early is a good sign. The tight end will likely be limited as he builds back up, but he could be in line to start the season barring any setbacks.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tyus Bowser works out for Texans
items.desc: Edge rusher Tyus Bowser is working out on Tuesday for the Houston Texans.
items.impact: Bowser last appeared in nine games for the Seahawks and Dolphins in 2024.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Hjalte Froholdt signs two-year extension with Cardinals
items.desc: The Cardinals signed C Hjalte Froholdt to a two-year, $20 million contract extension.
items.impact: Froholdt has been a full-time starter with Arizona since 2023. He remains a staple of the offensive line for the Cardinals.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kareem Hunt visits Lions
items.desc: Free agent RB Kareem Hunt visited the Lions on Tuesday.
items.impact: Hunt would figure to compete with Isiah Pacheco for the backup role behind Jahmyr Gibbs if he signs with Detroit.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kenneth Walker III (foot) not practicing Tuesday
items.desc: Kenneth Walker III is not practicing on Tuesday due to a foot injury.
items.impact: It is unclear how serious the injury is for Walker. His status will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Alec Pierce (ankle) will 'hopefully' practice this week
items.desc: Alec Pierce (ankle) will 'hopefully' return to practice this week for the Colts, according to HC Shane Steichen.
items.impact: Pierce has been sidelined for the entire preseason due to a nagging ankle injury  that he is recovering from. He seems to be closing in on a return, however, as he may be able to return to practice later this week. He will need some time to get fully up to speed before he pays off in fantasy, however, so fantasy managers should pay close attention to all updates about his health moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ty Johnson (leg) progressing with recovery
items.desc: Ty Johnson (leg) didn't practice on Tuesday but has resumed running.
items.impact: Johnson was technically a non-participant at Buffalo's practice on Tuesday, but he seems to be progressing well with his recovery and has resumed running. The team isn't certain whether or not he will be ready for Week 1 at this point, but his status doesn't have much of an impact for fantasy purposes.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Parker Washington (undisclosed) participating in practice Tuesday
items.desc: Parker Washington (undisclosed) is participating in Jacksonville's practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Washington has been battling an undisclosed injury of some kind for a little while now, but he was back and participating at practice on Tuesday. That's a good sign that he is close to full health, especially considering that it was a joint practice with the Buccaneers. He seems to be fully on track to play in Week 1 and remains an intriguing late-round dart throw if healthy.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Emeka Egbuka (toe) not practicing Tuesday
items.desc: Emeka Egbuka (toe) is not taking part in Tampa Bay's practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Tampa Bay was missing their star wideout at practice on Tuesday. He's still recovering from a toe injury, and it remains unclear how much more time he will miss because of it. Fantasy managers should keep close tabs on his status to ensure that he'll be ready to play in time for Week 1.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tez Johnson (groin) participating at practice Tuesday
items.desc: Tez Johnson (groin) is participating at Tampa Bay's practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: The young wideout was able to participate in Tuesday's practice after missing some time due to a groin injury that he suffered earlier this month. He will play a bigger role for the Buccaneers if Emeka Egbuka (toe) or Jalen McMillan (knee) have to miss any time due to their injuries.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jalen McMillan (knee) not seen practicing Tuesday
items.desc: Jalen McMillan (knee) was not seen practicing for the Buccaneers on Tuesday.
items.impact: McMillan is still battling a knee issue of some kind and was not seen practicing for the Buccaneers on Tuesday. He could be in line for more work at practice if Emeka Egbuka (toe) remains sidelined for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Josh Allen won't play Thursday
items.desc: Josh Allen won't play in Thursday night's preseason finale against the Pittsburgh Steelers.
items.impact: Allen saw some action earlier on in the preseason, but he is set to be sidelined for the team's final preseason game on Thursday night. He is fully healthy at this point and looks primed for another huge season from a fantasy perspective.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Ashton Jeanty (ankle) uncertain for Week 1
items.desc: Ashton Jeanty is dealing with a lower ankle sprain and his status for Week 1 is uncertain.
items.impact: This is actually a positive development for Jeanty, as there was certainly some concern over a longer-term injury when the second-year running back went down this past Sunday. This could certainly drop Jeanty down some fantasy draft boards a bit, but he should be rolling at full strength by the second or third week of the season at the latest.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Ben Sinnott (oblique) dealing with oblique injury
items.desc: Ben Sinnott (oblique) is dealing with an oblique injury, per HC Dan Quinn.
items.impact: The third year tight end is primarily a depth option at this point with little fantasy value. That's not to say he hasn't shown potential, he just needs to be given the role. It doesn't seem like that's coming anytime soon though.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Jacorey Croskey-Merritt dealing with lower body injury
items.desc: Jacorey Croskey-Merritt is dealing with a lower body injury, per HC Dan Quinn.
items.impact: The running back was limited in practice on Monday with an undisclosed injury, and now we at least get clarification of a lower body injury. Which frankly is still a little vague. Fantasy managers will need to wait for more details on the exact extent of his injury, but if he's at least limited, it doesn't sound like it's anything too major.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Dylan Horton (Achilles) to miss the 2026 season
items.desc: Dylan Horton will miss the entirety of the 2026 season due to a torn Achilles.
items.impact: Tests confirmed the severity of Horton's injury on Monday. The fourth-year defensive end played in 16 games for the Texans last season, recording 26 tackles, 0.5 sacks, and one forced fumble.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Malik Nabers (knee) could be ready for Week 1
items.desc: Giants head coach John Harbaugh said "it's reasonable to assume" that Malik Nabers is trending toward being ready for Week 1.
items.impact: Nabers was able to practice on Monday without the red non-contact jersey. Barring a setback, he is trending towards being ready for the start of the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kayshon Boutte traded to Texans
items.desc: The Patriots are sending WR Kayshon Boutte to the Texans in exchange for safety Jaylen Reed and a 2028 seventh-round pick.
items.impact: Boutte has had his name in trade rumors for most of the offseason following the Patriots offseason additions of AJ Brown and Romeo Doubs. Boutte will get a fresh start in a wide open wide receiver room with Houston. He should compete for a role as a field stretcher for the Texans.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Makai Lemon (hamstring) practicing in full on Monday
items.desc: Makai Lemon (hamstring) is back to practicing fully for the first time in weeks. He returned to practice in a limited fashion last week, and is now practicing in full.
items.impact: This is huge for Lemon's development and integration into the offense. The more reps he gets, especially as a rookie, the better. He's looking like a potential draft steal if he can continue to stay healthy and improve his game.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: DeVonta Smith practicing fully on Monday
items.desc: Devonta Smith (hamstring) is practicing fully on Monday for the first time in three weeks. He returned in a limited fashion recently, but he is back to fully participating.
items.impact: It's great news for Smith as he works his way back from a hamstring injury. This should be the all the confidence boost fantasy managers needed to continue targeting him highly in drafts.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Daniel Carlson signs with Saints
items.desc: The Saints signed K Daniel Carlson.
items.impact: Carlson will compete with Tanner Brown and Charlie Smyth for the starting kicker job for New Orleans.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ryan Miller waived by Giants
items.desc: The Giants waived WR Ryan Miller.
items.impact: Miller will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.title: Zamir White traded to Saints
items.desc: Zamir White was traded to the New Orleans Saints on Sunday in exchange for Deion Jones.
items.impact: White is now heading to New Orleans after being picked up by the 49ers this offseason. The 26-year-old is likely being brought in as a depth piece behind Travis Etienne Jr. following the injury to Alvin Kamara, who is expected to be sidelined for a month with a sprained MCL.

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.title: Deion Jones traded to 49ers
items.desc: Deion Jones was traded to the San Francisco 49ers on Sunday in exchange for Zamir White.
items.impact: Jones is now on his way to the West Coast after signing with the Saints earlier in the month. The linebacker appeared in 17 games with Tampa Bay last season and will look to provide a veteran presence for the 49ers' linebacker room.

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.title: Bud Clark (leg) carted off from Sunday's preseason game
items.desc: Bud Clark was carted off from Sunday's preseason game with an apparent leg injury.
items.impact: Clark's lower right leg was put in an aircast before he was carted off, which is never a good sign. The 2026 second-round pick will likely be on the shelf to begin the season, but a timetable will likely become available at some point this week.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Alex Wright (Achilles) placed on season-ending IR
items.desc: Alex Wright (Achilles) has been placed on season-ending injured reserve with a torn Achilles.
items.impact: The 2025 breakout suffered the injury during practice on Thursday and will now miss the rest of the season. Wright was looking to build off of a career best 5.5 sack season, but will now have to turn his eyes onto 2027.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: George Kittle (Achilles) activated from PUP
items.desc: George Kittle (Achilles) has been activated off of the 49ers PUP. A big step towards playing Week 1.
items.impact: Kittle was trending towards playing in Week 1, and this is a big step in that direction. He could be stepping into a big target share, especially with Mike Evans and De'Zhaun Stribling dealing with injuries of their own. Granted, the receivers injuries don't sound serious, but they're still noteworthy.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Tyler Biadasz (knee) placed on season-ending injured reserve
items.desc: Tyler Biadasz (knee) has been placed on season-ending injured reserve by the Los Angeles Chargers according to Ari Meirov.
items.impact: Biadasz suffered the knee injury earlier in the week during practice, leaving a gaping hole in a Chargers offensive line that hoped the offensive lineman would fortify the center position after signing with the organization during free agency. Backup Jake Slaughter will now ramp up to take on increased snaps at center for head coach Jim Harbaugh as the regular season approaches.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: De'Zhaun Stribling (shoulder) day-to-day
items.desc: De'Zhaun Stribling is day-to-day with a shoulder injury.
items.impact: Stribling has shown out in the first two preseason games for San Francisco. The rookie has already established himself into what is expected to be an immediate role for the 49ers wide receiver room. The 49ers will likely be cautious with him heading into the regular season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rashawn Slater (knee) back practicing
items.desc: Rashawn Slater was back at practice on Saturday.
items.impact: Slater had missed eight consecutive practices after suffering a flare-up in his knee. He still has a few weeks to get ready for Week 1.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jake Bobo (knee) placed on IR
items.desc: The Seahawks placed WR Jake Bobo on injured reserve.
items.impact: Bobo suffered a serious knee injury during practice on Friday. His season is over. He signed a two-year, $5.5 million offer sheet with the Jaguars, as a restricted free agent that the Seahawks elected to match.

items.author: Cooper Kleinberg
items.title: Stefon Diggs expected to play against Lions
items.desc: Stefon Diggs is set to make his Commanders debut in the preseason on Saturday.
items.impact: Diggs will see his first action as a member of the Commanders. It will be worth tuning in to see what his exact role looks like.

items.author: Cooper Kleinberg
items.title: Jayden Daniels expected to play against Lions
items.desc: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels is set to start against the Lions on Saturday.
items.impact: Daniels had a very underwhelming sophomore campaign, largely due to injury. He and the starters will have an opportunity to build chemistry and momentum ahead of the regular season.

items.author: Cooper Kleinberg
items.title: Terry McLaurin expected to play against Lions
items.desc: Commanders WR Terry McLaurin is set to start against the Lions on Saturday.
items.impact: McLaurin enters the fantasy football season as a top-50 selection. He and Jayden Daniels will have an opportunity to build momentum ahead of the regular season.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Nick Chubb announces retirement
items.desc: Nick Chubb has announced his retirement from the NFL via his personal Instagram.
items.impact: Chubb had a great NFL career as one of the most taleneted runners of the football of his generation. Coming out of Georgia with questions surrounding his health, he ended his time in Cleveland as one of the best running backs the franchise has seen before moving to Houston last year. He ends his eight year career with four Pro-Bowls, over 7,300 rushing yards at five yards per carry, and 54 rushing touchdowns.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tory Horton to 'be out for a period of time'
items.desc: Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald said WR Tory Horton will be out "for a period of time."
items.impact: "He's still working through his stuff," Macdonald said. "He's going to be out for a period of time." Horton had his rookie season end early last year due to a shin injury. His status for Week 1 is uncertain.

items.author: Cooper Kleinberg
items.title: Zay Jones signing with Texans
items.desc: Veteran WR Zay Jones is signing with the Houston Texans
items.impact: Jones provides the Texans with some insurance at the WR position after Jayden Higgins suffered a season-ending injury. At age 31, however, he remains a player with minimal fantasy value.

items.author: Cooper Kleinberg
items.title: Sterling Shepard signing with Texans
items.desc: Veteran WR Sterling Shepard is signing with the Houston Texans
items.impact: Shepard signs with the Texans following Jayden Higgins' season-ending injury. Unfortunately, at age 33, he remains with little to no value in fantasy.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Reynolds linked to Texans
items.desc: Free agent WR Josh Reynolds has been linked to the Texans.
items.impact: Houston is holding workouts after losing Jayden Higgins for the season. Reynolds previously worked out for the Saints.

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.title: Jayden Higgins (knee) officially placed on season-ending IR
items.desc: The Houston Texans officially placed Jayden Higgins on the season-ending injured reserve with a torn ACL.
items.impact: This was expected after Higgins was announced to have torn his ACL in a joint practice with the Raiders on Tuesday. Nico Collins is now likely the only Houston receiver on the fantasy radar, with Tank Dell still working back to full health and Xavier Hutchinson likely going undrafted in fantasy drafts. Dalton Schultz could see more opportunity with this injury.

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.title: Tyreek Hill not expected to sign before Week 1
items.desc: Tyreek Hill is not expected to sign with a team before the season begins, according to his agent Drew Rosenhaus.
items.impact: Hill has been on the long road to recovery after sustaining a major knee injury in Week 4 last season, and it looks like he will remain a free agent when the 2026 season begins. However, the 32-year-old could receive interest from contenders as the season goes on if he continues to progress in his rehab.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Carnell Tate returns to practice Friday
items.desc: Titans rookie WR Carnell Tate returned to practice on Friday.
items.impact: Tate missed practice time earlier this week due to "stiffness." The rookie could see some more reps in Sunday's preseason game against the Seahawks.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ennis Rakestraw Jr. suffers leg injury Thursday
items.desc: Ennis Rakestraw Jr. left practice early on Thursday with a leg injury.
items.impact: It is unclear how serious the injury is. Rakestraw is day-to-day for now.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jimmy Rolder (leg) not ready to return to practice
items.desc: Lions coach Dan Campbell says Jimmy Rolder isn't likely to return to practice by next week.
items.impact: Rolder went down with a leg injury earlier in August. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Roydell Williams released by Colts
items.desc: The Colts released Roydell Williams.
items.impact: Indianapolis signed WR Keenan Allen as the corresponding move.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Timothy McKay waived by Jaguars
items.desc: The Jaguars waived OL Timothy McKay.
items.impact: McKay will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Luke Grimm waived by Chargers
items.desc: The Chargers waived WR Luke Grimm with an injury designation.
items.impact: Grimm will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp when he is cleared.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Liam Clifford signs with Chargers
items.desc: The Chargers signed WR Liam Clifford.
items.impact: Clifford will compete for a depth role in the Chargers wide receiver room.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jeadyn Lukus waived by Browns
items.desc: The Browns waived CB Jeadyn Lukus.
items.impact: Lukus signed with Cleveland earlier in August. He'll figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jamil Muhammad signs with Browns
items.desc: The Browns signed DL Jamil Muhammad.
items.impact: Muhammad spent time with both the Rams and Panthers last season. He'll compete for a depth role on the Browns defensive line.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chase Lucas released by Bucs
items.desc: The Buccaneers released CB Chase Lucas with a four-week injury settlement.
items.impact: Lucas suffered a calf injury. He is expected to draw heavy interest when he is cleared.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Matthew McDoom signs with Bengals
items.desc: The Bengals signed CB Matthew McDoom.
items.impact: McDoom will compete for a depth role in the Bengals corner back room.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Carson Beck (ribs) unlikely to play Saturday
items.desc: Carson Beck (ribs) is unlikely to play in Saturday's preseason game against the Dallas Cowboys.
items.impact: Beck recently suffered an injury to his ribs. It's not considered a serious issue at this point, but it still looks like the team will have him sit out on Saturday as a precautionary measure. Gardner Minshew II is in line to be Arizona's starter against the Cowboys, assuming the 24-year old is officially ruled out ahead of game time.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jacoby Brissett won't play Saturday
items.desc: Jacoby Brissett won't play in Saturday's preseason game against the Dallas Cowboys.
items.impact: The veteran quarterback will not suit up on Saturday. He took part in the team's first preseason game, but they apparently don't feel that he needs more reps and will let him sit out of their next game. Gardner Minshew II is expected to be the starter with Carson Beck (ribs) unlikely to play as well.

items.author: Cooper Kleinberg
items.title: Joey Porter Jr. drawing trade interest
items.desc: Steelers CB Joey Porter Jr. is reportedly drawing interest on the trade market.
items.impact: Porter is currently on the NFL's PUP list and is reportedly seeking a contract extension. He could be on the move with the regular season approaching.

items.author: Cooper Kleinberg
items.title: Deebo Samuel Sr. starting against Chargers
items.desc: 49ers WR Deebo Samuel Sr. will play against the Chargers in the preseason
items.impact: Thursday night's contest could offer a closer look at the type of role Samuel will have in the 49ers' offense this season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Fernando Mendoza to play roughly first half Thursday
items.desc: Fernando Mendoza is expected to play roughly the first half in Thursday's preseason game against the Texans.
items.impact: Mendoza will get extended run on the field in his second preseason game. Aidan O'Connell will take the field in the second half.
